Name: Dial Countdown
Author: Mate Wish Key

Actions.Name: Countdown
Actions.Tooltip: A countdown timer on a dial. Tap the screen to pause or resume, tap twice to reset it to full, hold for the next preset. Turn the dial to adjust; press it to swap between one-second and one-minute steps, or hold it for one hour.

TriggerDescription.LongTouch: Put the clock right, then next preset

Actions.Name: Countdown (Key)
Actions.Tooltip: The same countdown timer on an ordinary key. Press to pause or resume, press twice to reset it to full, hold to load the next preset.

Description: Countdown timers for the Stream Deck + dials and for ordinary keys. Tap to pause or resume, tap twice to reset, hold for the next preset — and on a dial, turn to adjust, with a step you set yourself: press for one-second or one-minute clicks, hold for one hour.
